rationale: C05 is an exceptionally close drafting template issued only seventeen days earlier. The child preserves its complete sequence of factual recitals and operative provisions nearly verbatim, changing principally the carrier and represented employees. C03 and C18 share essentially the same language and machinery, but C05 is the strongest candidate because it is the most recent preceding example and matches the child's wording exactly on such details as “with respect to the dispute” and “or by its employees.”

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the New York Central System, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Order of Railway Conductors and Brakemen, a labor organization
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Atchison, Topeka and Santa Fe Railway Company—Coast Lines, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Brotherhood of Locomotive Engineers, a labor organization
shared_material.explanation: The same party-and-union recital is reused with the carrier and labor organization substituted.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the Judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to Interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a section of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a section of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.explanation: The statutory and emergency findings are substantively verbatim; capitalization differences appear merely typographical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the New York Central System, or by its employees, in the conditions out of which the dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Atchison, Topeka and Santa Fe Railway Company—Coast Lines, or by its employees, in the conditions out of which the dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The operative status-quo mechanism is copied verbatim apart from substitution of the carrier name.
